userGuide.settingHint: Hidden if you already know Track Studio. Rekordbox users see differences only. Can be changed anytime.

identity.title: Select how you use Track Studio
identity.line1: This controls whether the guide is shown and how it is worded.
identity.line2: You can change this in Settings.
identity.rekordboxDesc: Explain differences from Rekordbox. Shared concepts are not repeated.
identity.veteranDesc: Do not show the guide. You can turn it back on in Settings.

rekordbox.title: Track source
rekordbox.line1: Use Import or New playlist to add audio files to Filter.
rekordbox.hint: Click Import or New playlist.

general.title: Track source
general.line1: Use Import to add audio files to Filter.
general.hint: Click Import or New playlist.

rekordbox.title: Browser mode
rekordbox.line1: This corresponds to Rekordbox Browser.
rekordbox.hint: Switch to Dual-Track Horizontal or Edit from this menu.

general.title: Browser mode
general.line1: Browse, play, and organize tracks. Double-click to play.
general.hint: Switch to Dual-Track Horizontal or Edit from this menu.

rekordbox.title: Music library
rekordbox.line1: Rekordbox does not have this sidebar.
rekordbox.line2: It includes Filter, Curated, SET Library, Mixtape Auto-Recording, and Recycle Bin.
rekordbox.hint: Click an icon to switch.

general.title: Music library
general.line1: Includes Filter, Curated, SET Library, Mixtape Auto-Recording, and Recycle Bin.
general.hint: Click an icon to switch.

rekordbox.title: Music library context menu
rekordbox.line1: Rekordbox does not have this entry.
rekordbox.line2: Right-click an icon for library-wide actions such as auto-fill metadata, convert format, or find similar tracks.
rekordbox.hint: Right-click a sidebar icon.

general.title: Music library context menu
general.line1: Right-click a sidebar icon for library-wide actions.
general.line2: Includes auto-fill metadata, convert format, and similar tracks. Recycle Bin can be emptied here.
general.hint: Right-click a sidebar icon.

rekordbox.title: Playlists
rekordbox.line1: Similar to Rekordbox playlists, but each playlist is a folder on disk.
rekordbox.hint: Search above the tree.

general.title: Playlists
general.line1: Click a playlist to list its tracks. Each playlist is a folder on disk.
general.hint: Search above the tree.

rekordbox.title: Playlist context menu
rekordbox.line1: Right-click a playlist or empty area.
rekordbox.line2: Import and export apply to folders on disk. You can open them in File Explorer.
rekordbox.hint: Right-click a playlist or empty area.

general.title: Playlist context menu
general.line1: Right-click a playlist or empty area.
general.line2: Create, import, export, rename, delete, and open the folder in File Explorer.
general.hint: Right-click a playlist or empty area.

rekordbox.title: Player bar
rekordbox.line1: Shown during playback for preview.
rekordbox.hint: Hidden when nothing is playing.

general.title: Player bar
general.line1: Shows cover, progress, and volume during playback.
general.hint: Hidden when nothing is playing.

rekordbox.title: Track source
rekordbox.line1: Use Import or New playlist to add audio files to Filter.
rekordbox.hint: Click Import or New playlist.

general.title: Track source
general.line1: Use Import to add audio files to Filter.
general.hint: Click Import or New playlist.

rekordboxUsbBody.title: Rekordbox Library and Rekordbox USB library
rekordboxUsbBody.line1: The Rekordbox Library and connected Rekordbox USB libraries appear in the lower left.
rekordboxUsbBody.line2: You can browse and preview. Copy into Filter to organize; source libraries are not modified.
rekordboxUsbBody.hint: Click the corresponding icon to open.

rekordboxUsbMenu.title: Rekordbox Library and Rekordbox USB context menu
rekordboxUsbMenu.line1: Right-click an icon to import artists into Curated, scan fingerprints, or eject USB.
rekordboxUsbMenu.line2: After opening, right-click a playlist or track to copy into Filter. Source libraries are not modified.

rekordbox.title: Track list
rekordbox.line1: Select and double-click to play as in Rekordbox.
rekordbox.hint: Click a column header to sort. Use the column filter icon to filter.

general.title: Track list
general.line1: Double-click to play.
general.hint: Click a column header to sort. Use the column filter icon to filter.

rekordbox.title: Index and drag
rekordbox.line1: Unlike Rekordbox, drag-and-drop reordering works only when sorted by Index.
rekordbox.line2: When sorted by another column, use Renumber by current order on the Index column to save the visible order as real track numbers.
rekordbox.hint: Click the Index header to change sort.

general.title: Index and drag
general.line1: Drag-and-drop reordering works only when sorted by Index.
general.line2: When sorted by another column, use Renumber by current order on the Index column to save the visible order as real track numbers.
general.hint: Click the Index header to change sort.

rekordbox.title: Track context menu
rekordbox.line1: Copy or move tracks into Filter or Curated to organize.
rekordbox.line2: Export, metadata, convert, and stems are also here. Rekordbox source libraries are not modified.
rekordbox.hint: Right-click a track.

general.title: Track context menu
general.line1: Copy or move to Filter or Curated, or add to a SET or Mixtape.
general.line2: You can also export, edit metadata, convert format, or separate stems.
general.hint: Right-click a track.

rekordbox.title: List header
rekordbox.line1: Right-click the header to show or hide columns.
rekordbox.hint: Right-click the header.

general.title: List header
general.line1: Right-click the header to show or hide columns.
general.hint: Right-click the header.

filterCurated.title: Filter and Curated
filterCurated.line1: Filter is for initial review. Curated stores selected tracks.
filterCurated.hint: These two icons on the left.

rekordbox.title: SET Library
rekordbox.line1: Like Rekordbox playlists, a SET stores references, not a folder of copies.
rekordbox.line2: Remove from SET does not delete the source files.
rekordbox.hint: Add tracks from the track context menu.

general.title: SET Library
general.line1: A SET stores track references, not copies of files.
general.line2: Remove from SET does not delete the source files.
general.hint: Add tracks from the track context menu.

rekordbox.title: Mixtape Auto-Recording
rekordbox.line1: Rekordbox has no equivalent. Double-click a playlist to open a separate window.
rekordbox.line2: Tracks need a BPM before they can be added.
rekordbox.hint: Double-click a playlist on the left.

general.title: Mixtape Auto-Recording
general.line1: Double-click a playlist to open a separate auto-recording window.
general.line2: Tracks need a BPM before they can be added.
general.hint: Double-click a playlist on the left.

recordingLibrary.title: Recordings
recordingLibrary.line1: This library appears after a dual-track recording.
recordingLibrary.line2: Recorded files are stored here. Source tracks are not changed.
recordingLibrary.hint: Start recording from the dual-track title bar only.

rekordbox.title: Dual-Track Horizontal mode
rekordbox.line1: Corresponds to Rekordbox Export.
rekordbox.hint: Double-click loads the top deck. Shift+double-click loads the bottom deck.

general.title: Dual-Track Horizontal mode
general.line1: Compare two decks’ waveforms to judge a transition.
general.hint: Double-click loads the top deck. Shift+double-click loads the bottom deck.

rekordbox.title: Waveforms
rekordbox.line1: The center pair of horizontal waveforms is for comparing phrases.
rekordbox.hint: Drag to seek. Scroll to zoom.

general.title: Waveforms
general.line1: The center pair of horizontal waveforms lets you compare phrases.
general.hint: Drag to seek. Scroll to zoom.

rekordbox.title: Playback and faders
rekordbox.line1: Play, volume, and the crossfader work as in Export.
rekordbox.line2: The left CUE is playback cue. The CUE beside the fader is cue monitor.
rekordbox.hint: EQ bands and cue monitor appear when the fader panel is expanded.

general.title: Playback and faders
general.line1: The left CUE is for playback position.
general.line2: The CUE that appears when the fader panel is expanded is cue monitor, not seek.
general.hint: EQ bands and cue monitor appear when the fader panel is expanded.

rekordbox.title: Link
rekordbox.line1: Rekordbox has no equivalent button.
rekordbox.line2: When on, dragging or zooming either deck moves both together and aligns the grids.
rekordbox.hint: Available after both decks are loaded. It does not rewrite either beat grid.

general.title: Link
general.line1: When on, dragging or zooming either deck moves both together and aligns the grids.
general.hint: Available after both decks are loaded. It does not rewrite either beat grid.

rekordbox.title: Beat Sync and MASTER
rekordbox.line1: These mean the same as in Rekordbox.
rekordbox.line2: Unlike Link: Beat Sync only aligns tempo. It does not drag or zoom both decks as one.
rekordbox.hint: MASTER chooses the reference deck. It is not the MT button on the toolbar.

general.title: Beat Sync and MASTER
general.line1: MASTER chooses the reference deck. Beat Sync aligns the current deck to that tempo.
general.line2: Unlike Link: it only aligns tempo. It does not drag or zoom both decks as one.
general.hint: MASTER is on the track info card, not the MT button on the toolbar.

rekordbox.title: Loop and tempo
rekordbox.line1: Loop and Quantize match Rekordbox.
rekordbox.line2: BPM here is a temporary speed change. MT locks pitch while tempo changes; it is not MASTER.
rekordbox.hint: Edit the grid in Edit mode. The metronome is not recorded.

general.title: Loop and tempo
general.line1: Use Loop, Quantize, and temporary tempo adjustments.
general.line2: BPM here affects playback only. MT locks pitch while tempo changes; it is not MASTER.
general.hint: The metronome is for listening only and is not recorded.

rekordbox.title: Hot Cue and Memory Cue
rekordbox.line1: These mean the same as in Rekordbox.
rekordbox.hint: Switch cue types on the right.

general.title: Hot Cue and Memory Cue
general.line1: Set or jump to Hot Cues and Memory Cues on the right.
general.hint: Use the buttons under the panel to switch types.

rekordbox.title: Recording
rekordbox.line1: Recording is only available from the dual-track title bar. Rekordbox has no equivalent control here.
rekordbox.line2: When finished, the Recordings library appears in the sidebar.
rekordbox.hint: Click the record button in the title bar.

general.title: Recording
general.line1: Recording is only available from the dual-track title bar.
general.line2: When finished, the Recordings library appears in the sidebar.
general.hint: Click the record button in the title bar.

rekordbox.title: Edit mode
rekordbox.line1: Corresponds to Rekordbox Edit. Use it to edit the beat grid.
rekordbox.hint: BPM here edits the grid, not a temporary pitch change.

general.title: Edit mode
general.line1: Edit the beat grid of the current track.
general.hint: BPM here changes the analysis result, not playback speed immediately.

rekordbox.title: Grid segments
rekordbox.line1: After playhead only changes the grid to the right of the playhead.
rekordbox.hint: Use the range buttons on the toolbar.

general.title: Grid segments
general.line1: After playhead only changes the grid to the right of the playhead.
general.hint: Use the range buttons on the toolbar.

rekordbox.title: Mixtape Auto-Recording
rekordbox.line1: Rekordbox has no equivalent window. Tracks are arranged on a timeline and joined automatically.
rekordbox.hint: Drag tracks from a playlist. A BPM is required first.

general.title: Mixtape Auto-Recording
general.line1: Tracks are arranged on a timeline and joined automatically.
general.hint: Drag tracks from a playlist. A BPM is required first.

rekordbox.title: Automation
rekordbox.line1: Switch a parameter, then edit its curve or position on the timeline.
rekordbox.line2: In Position, Shift-drag also moves following tracks.
rekordbox.hint: Use the tabs above.

general.title: Automation
general.line1: Switch a parameter, then edit its curve or position on the timeline.
general.line2: In Position, Shift-drag also moves following tracks.
general.hint: Use the tabs above.

rekordbox.title: Tempo envelope
rekordbox.line1: When on, you can edit BPM for the whole timeline.
rekordbox.line2: This is not the MT button on the dual-track toolbar.
rekordbox.hint: Click BPM to turn it on or off.

general.title: Tempo envelope
general.line1: When on, you can edit BPM for the whole timeline.
general.line2: This is not the MT button on the dual-track toolbar.
general.hint: Click BPM to turn it on or off.

rekordbox.title: Stems
rekordbox.line1: Separated stems last only until you quit the app. Opening again requires a new separation.
rekordbox.hint: Use Vocal / Inst and similar tabs on the timeline.

general.title: Stems
general.line1: Separated stems last only until you quit the app. Opening again requires a new separation.
general.hint: Use Vocal / Inst and similar tabs on the timeline.
